description: Revert to the proven aggressive learning rate configuration (Matrix LR 0.11, Embedding LR 1.4) with Depth 10 and Batch 128, as historical data consistently shows this setup achieves better convergence (~0.983 bpb) within the 5-minute time budget, whereas the conservative LR (0.08) used in the current best run (0.9800) likely under-utilized the time by converging too slowly or oscillating.
